source_meta._title: Parity Issue: Allays pick up arrow/potion items with other effects than the ones they're holding

stor.environment: Vanilla Minecraft Java Edition 22w15a in a new single-player Creative-mode world on the integrated server. Use a Superflat world or another open, level area to simplify keeping the allay and dropped item visible. Cheats must be available so the mobGriefing game rule can be confirmed.
preconditions: Launch the exact affected snapshot 22w15a, not the fix version 22w42a or a later release.
Use an unmodded client with no gameplay-changing data packs.
Use a new Creative-mode world with cheats enabled. No particular seed or coordinates are specified by the report.
Keep the test area free of unrelated dropped items and use only one allay.
The mobGriefing game rule must be true; allays cannot collect dropped items when it is false.

Prepare an Arrow of Night Vision as the item handed to the allay and an Arrow of Invisibility as the differently affected tipped arrow dropped for the test. Both must be tipped arrows, not ordinary or spectral arrows.
The instructions refer to default controls. If controls are rebound, use the bindings for Inventory, Use Item/Place Block, Select Hotbar Slot, Chat, and Drop Selected Item.

steps.action: In the Minecraft Launcher, create or select an installation for Java Edition snapshot 22w15a, launch it, and wait for the main menu to finish loading.
steps.success_cue: The main menu is responsive and displays 22w15a as the running version.

steps.action: Select Singleplayer, choose Create New World, set Game Mode to Creative, and ensure cheats are enabled. For a deterministic open test area, select More World Options and cycle World Type to Superflat, then create the world. Wait until terrain has rendered and movement responds normally.
steps.success_cue: The player is standing in a fully loaded Creative-mode world with an open, level area available.

steps.action: Press T to open in-game chat. Enter the command exactly as shown, including the leading slash, and press Enter. This ensures allays are permitted to collect dropped items.
steps.success_cue: Chat confirms that the mobGriefing game rule is now set to true.

steps.action: Press E to open the Creative inventory. Open the Search Items tab, identified by its compass icon, click the search field, and search for an allay. Hover over the result whose tooltip says Allay Spawn Egg and press 3 to put a stack in hotbar slot 3.
steps.success_cue: Hotbar slot 3 contains an Allay Spawn Egg.

steps.action: While still in the Creative inventory's Search Items tab, replace the search text with the exact item name shown. Locate a tipped-arrow result whose tooltip identifies it as an Arrow of Night Vision, hover over it, and press 1 to put it in hotbar slot 1. Do not select an ordinary Arrow or Spectral Arrow.
steps.success_cue: Hotbar slot 1 contains tipped arrows identified by the tooltip as Arrow of Night Vision.

steps.action: Replace the search text with the exact second item name. Locate a tipped-arrow result whose tooltip identifies it as an Arrow of Invisibility, hover over it, and press 2 to put it in hotbar slot 2. The effect must be Invisibility so it is different from the Night Vision arrow in slot 1.
steps.success_cue: Hotbar slot 2 contains tipped arrows identified by the tooltip as Arrow of Invisibility, while slot 1 still contains Arrow of Night Vision.

steps.action: Close the Creative inventory by pressing E or Esc. Press 3 to select the Allay Spawn Egg in hotbar slot 3, then aim at the ground in the open test area.
steps.success_cue: The Allay Spawn Egg is visible in the player's hand and its name appears above the hotbar.

steps.action: Use the selected spawn egg once by right-clicking one ground block. Do not repeatedly click or create additional allays.
steps.success_cue: Exactly one allay is flying near the targeted ground block.

steps.action: Press 1 to select the Arrow of Night Vision stack in hotbar slot 1. Confirm the item name above the hotbar before continuing.
steps.success_cue: Arrow of Night Vision is the active hotbar item and is visible in the player's hand.

steps.action: Place the crosshair directly over the allay and press the Use Item/Place Block control once, which is right-click by default. Do not attack the allay. The interaction gives one Arrow of Night Vision to it.
steps.success_cue: The allay visibly holds an arrow, begins following the player, and the Arrow of Night Vision stack in slot 1 has decreased by one.

steps.action: Press 2 to select the Arrow of Invisibility stack. Do not use this arrow on the allay; it must be dropped as an item entity.
steps.success_cue: Arrow of Invisibility is the active hotbar item and its name appears above the hotbar, while the allay continues holding the previously given arrow.

steps.action: Move into the open test area and stop when the allay holding the arrow is approximately 2 to 3 blocks away. Face the allay and angle the crosshair slightly downward toward a clear ground block beside it. Ensure no other dropped items are present and do not stand directly on the intended landing point.
steps.success_cue: The arrow-holding allay is nearby, the ground between the player and allay is clear, and the player is ready to throw the selected Arrow of Invisibility toward it.

steps.action: Remain still until the surrounding area is fully rendered, player input is responsive, and the allay is still visible within a few blocks. Keep Arrow of Invisibility selected.
steps.success_cue: The world is responsive, the allay is holding an arrow nearby, and Arrow of Invisibility remains selected.

steps.action: Press the Drop Selected Item control once, Q by default, without holding Ctrl. This drops one Arrow of Invisibility toward the ground beside the allay. Do not walk onto the dropped item or press Q repeatedly.
steps.success_cue: One Arrow of Invisibility item entity has just appeared on the ground near the allay while the allay is still holding the Arrow of Night Vision.

stor.handoff_condition: One Arrow of Invisibility has just been dropped as an item entity within reach of the allay that was previously given an Arrow of Night Vision. The player is not standing on the dropped item. Begin observing the allay's interaction with that dropped arrow immediately.
uncertainties: The report does not specify a game mode, world type, seed, or coordinates. A new Creative-mode world and an open Superflat area are practical execution choices, not reported requirements.
The report specifies a Night Vision tipped arrow only as an example and does not name the second effect. Arrow of Invisibility was selected as a deterministic, clearly different tipped-arrow effect.
A comment states that the issue was present in "1.19 Pre-3," but that string is not included in the report's formal Affects versions field, so it was not added to affected_versions.
Comments also mention potions, splash potions, and lingering potions, but the primary Steps to Reproduce use tipped arrows; this plan intentionally reproduces only that supplied arrow variant.
